summary.rootCause: POST /admin/v1/projects/:id/media/register-existing carrying approvalStatus:'approved'. project-media-import.service.ts applyMetadata() line ~710: `if (dto.approvalStatus) asset.approvalStatus = dto.approvalStatus`. A re-run of the importer with that field set rewrites approval on every already-registered path.
